selectionCriteria.scientificValue: Provides 684 strictly isolated source_ids across 2 splits, supporting fixed test evaluation (343 sources) and paired bootstrap 95% CI
selectionCriteria.bandwidthFootprint: 5.88 GB download vs 25.89 GB full dataset (77.3% bandwidth reduction)
selectionCriteria.diskEfficiency: 14.7 GB required headroom vs 64.7 GB (comfortably within 99.71 GB available disk)
selectionCriteria.thesisScope: Focuses thesis on few-data learning curve efficiency (MobileNetV3) rather than brute-force big data compute
selectionCriteria.reproducibility: Fully deterministic split archives with verifiable ETags and upstream provenance

option_s_smallest_engineering_subset.name: Option S — Smallest Engineering Subset
option_s_smallest_engineering_subset.scientificPurpose: End-to-end engineering smoke validation of paired dataset loader, patch sliding window, and training step mechanics
option_s_smallest_engineering_subset.supportedClaims: Data loader correctness, training pipeline smoke execution, memory profiling
option_s_smallest_engineering_subset.unsupportedClaims: Model generalization, statistical significance, detection performance metrics

option_p_small_data_pilot.name: Option P — Small-Data Thesis Pilot (Recommended)
option_p_small_data_pilot.scientificPurpose: Execute few-data learning curve protocol (N=50, 100, 250 source_id samples) with strictly isolated fixed test benchmark (343 sources) and paired bootstrap 95% CI evaluation
option_p_small_data_pilot.supportedClaims: Sample efficiency of lightweight backbones, statistical validation vs baselines (Dummy, Metadata, DSP), selective abstention efficacy
option_p_small_data_pilot.unsupportedClaims: Universal generalization to unseen generator families (e.g., GANs, Autoregressive) without Pilot B/C

option_f_full_pilot_a.name: Option F — Full Pilot A
option_f_full_pilot_a.scientificPurpose: Complete asymptotic benchmark reproduction across all 3,124 TGIF inpainting task instances
option_f_full_pilot_a.supportedClaims: Asymptotic accuracy of full-scale inpainting detection, full paper reproduction
option_f_full_pilot_a.unsupportedClaims: Cross-generator generalization without external test sets
